rules.message: Interactive <Button>/<button> nested inside <a> violates HTML5 content model and creates double tab stops; retrieve interactive-link-button-semantics.
keepWhen: Never valid in rendered HTML5 DOM; refactor to a single <a> styled via buttonVariants() or verified Radix Slot.
dropWhen: Match occurs inside a string literal, code comment, or negative test fixture deliberately asserting invalid markup.

rules.message: focus:outline-none removes keyboard focus indicator without a focus-visible replacement on the same line; retrieve accessible-validation-and-ime.
keepWhen: Input sits inside a composite field wrapper that visibly highlights via parent has-[:focus-visible]:ring-* styling.
dropWhen: A focus-visible:ring-* or focus-visible:outline-* utility is already applied on an adjacent line inside cn()/clsx().

rules.message: Avoid JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...)) for in-memory cloning or sorting; retrieve modern-clone-sort-groupby-abort.
keepWhen: Caller intentionally normalizes wire JSON by invoking .toJSON(), converting Date instances to ISO strings, or stripping undefined keys.
Input may contain functions, DOM nodes, or unwrapped reactive Proxy instances that throw DataCloneError in structuredClone.
dropWhen: Match is in a serialization test fixture, generated SDK, or third-party vendor file.

rules.message: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') parses as UTC midnight and shifts calendar dates backward in negative UTC timezones; retrieve postgres-utc-calendar-dates.
keepWhen: Result is exclusively read via getUTCFullYear/getUTCMonth/getUTCDate or formatted with explicit timeZone: 'UTC'.
dropWhen: Test explicitly probes UTC-midnight vs local-timezone boundary behavior.
